episodeTitle.en: Relentless curiosity, radical accountability, and HubSpot’s winning growth formula | Chris Miller
episodeTitle.zh: 永不止息的好奇心、彻底的责任感，以及HubSpot的制胜增长公式 | 克里斯·米勒

guestBioOfficial.en: Christopher Miller serves as the VP of Product for Growth and AI at HubSpot. Having spent the past seven years at HubSpot, Chris has been at the center of one of the biggest B2B growth stories in history—leading HubSpot’s early growth strategy, their shift to PLG, and now their investment in AI. Beyond his role at HubSpot, he lends his expertise to founders advising them on PLG and their growth strategy broadly. In today’s podcast, we discuss: • The principles of winning teams, careers, and companies
guestBioOfficial.zh: 克里斯·米勒现任HubSpot增长与AI产品副总裁。在HubSpot工作的过去七年里，克里斯始终处于B2B增长史上最传奇篇章的核心人物——他主导了HubSpot的早期增长战略、向PLG模式的转型，以及如今对AI的投资。除HubSpot的角色外，他还为初创企业提供咨询服务，助力他们制定PLG策略和整体增长战略。在本期播客中，我们将探讨：• 成功团队、职业生涯和公司的核心原则

title.en: Relentless curiosity, radical accountability, and HubSpot’s winning growth formula | Chris Miller
title.zh: 永不止息的好奇心、彻底的责任感，以及HubSpot的制胜增长公式 | 克里斯·米勒

summary.en: Chris covers what it takes to become a successful product leader, the skills the best PMs build, and how to find mentors early in your career. He emphasizes radical ownership and accountability—treating every problem as yours—as the mindset that helped HubSpot's growth team find opportunities others missed. The conversation also stresses why early PMs must “scrape their knees” to learn.
summary.zh: Chris 涵盖了成为成功产品领导者需要什么、顶尖 PM 培养的技能，以及职业生涯早期如何找到导师。他强调“彻底的拥有感与责任感”——把每个问题都当成自己的——这一心态帮助 HubSpot 增长团队发现别人错过的机会。对话还强调早期 PM 必须“摔跟头”才能学到东西。
